title: King with Children and Skulls
coreRelationships: The king figure dominates the upper and central composition, acting as a focal point.
The children and skulls are clustered below the king, visually linked to him by his robe.
The vibrant, painterly background creates a dramatic and intense atmosphere.
The contrast between the king's regal attire and the suffering children creates a strong narrative tension.
The upward gaze of the king contrasts with the downward or vacant gazes of the children and skulls.
reuseFormula: Generate a central, dominant king figure in regal attire with a pained expression, looking upwards. Below and emerging from his robe, depict a cluster of children and skulls, some showing signs of addiction. The background should be a highly textured, painterly blend of red, orange, and purple. Ensure the overall style mimics an oil painting with visible brushstrokes. Add a small, white, lowercase sans-serif caption in the top-right corner.
